name: The Disappeared Courier
description: A transit courier named Halden has stopped filing cargo manifests. The Records Clerk in the Archives wants answers.

ask_calloway.label: Ask Calloway About Halden
ask_calloway.description: Talk to Station Master Calloway at Meridian Station about the missing courier.

completionActions.text: Calloway says Halden left his logbook behind. It might have ended up in the Market Quarter.

find_logbook.label: Find Halden's Logbook
find_logbook.description: Search the Market Quarter for the courier's dropped logbook.

completionActions.text: The logbook shows rerouted shipments. The Records Clerk needs to see this.

return_to_clerk.label: Return the Logbook to the Records Clerk
return_to_clerk.description: Bring Halden's logbook back to the Records Clerk in the Archives.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: The Disappeared Courier. The smuggling operation has been exposed.
